[[Captain/Legends|Captain]] '''Selgo''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Officer/Legends|officer]]. Assigned to [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]], Selgo's assignment was to protect the new [[Governor/Legends|governor]], [[Henris Octavian]].<ref name="Game" />
